name: Hosaka Hina
source: [url=/c27785]Shoutarou's[/url] classmate, childhood friend and neighbour. She often stays with Shoutarou, whom she calls "Shou-chan", and his mother due to her parents working and rarely coming home. Every morning, Hina storms into Shoutarou's room and demands him to make breakfast and lunch for her. Loves Shoutarou very much and anything he cooks for her.
